metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, captured with MODIS Terra, in New York higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1), date = 2016-07-20 to 2016-07-27 and 2001-07-20 to 2010-07-27, location = New York City (point). 2. Masking strategy: Use only the QC-flag to keep good-quality LST pixels (no clouds). 3. Logic: Compute mean LST for each period, compare. Print means, pixel counts, cloud stats. If either collection is empty → C1, if valid-pixels = 0 → C2, if result None/NaN → C3, else A/B. ```python import ee ee.Authenticate() ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions ny = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.006, 40.7128]) # NYC doy = (7, 20, 27) def filt(year_span): return (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*doy, 'day_of_year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*year_span, 'year')) .select('LST_Day_1km') .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day') .eq(0))) # good quality only .mean() .multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)) # scale to °C # 2. Data Acquisition & Check ref = filt([2001, 2010]) tar = filt([2016, 2016]) for era, col, yrs in [('2016', tar, 2016), ('2001-2010', ref, None)]: sz = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1')\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*doy, 'day_of_year'))\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001 if yrs is None else yrs, 2010 if yrs is None else yrs, 'year'))\ .size().getInfo() if sz == 0: print(f"No images for {era}.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Calculate means and counts def stats(img, label): cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=ny, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=ny, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if cnt == 0 or val is None: return None, 0 print(f"{label}: {val:.2f} °C (pixels: {int(cnt)})") return val, int(cnt) ref_val, ref_cnt = stats(ref, "2001-2010 avg") tar_val, tar_cnt = stats(tar, "2016") if ref_cnt == 0 or tar_cnt == 0: print("C2") exit() if ref_val is None or tar_val is None: print("C3") exit() print("A" if tar_val > ref_val else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Authenticate()
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
ny = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.006, 40.7128])  # NYC
doy = (7, 20, 27)

def filt(year_span):
    return (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1')
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*doy, 'day_of_year'))
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*year_span, 'year'))
              .select('LST_Day_1km')
              .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day')
                                               .eq(0)))  # good quality only
              .mean()
              .multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15))  # scale to °C

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
ref = filt([2001, 2010])
tar = filt([2016, 2016])
for era, col, yrs in [('2016', tar, 2016), ('2001-2010', ref, None)]:
    sz = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1')\
           .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(*doy, 'day_of_year'))\
           .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001 if yrs is None else yrs,
                                           2010 if yrs is None else yrs, 'year'))\
           .size().getInfo()
    if sz == 0:
        print(f"No images for {era}.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 3. Calculate means and counts
def stats(img, label):
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                           geometry=ny, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\
             .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=ny, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)\
             .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0 or val is None:
        return None, 0
    print(f"{label}: {val:.2f} °C (pixels: {int(cnt)})")
    return val, int(cnt)

ref_val, ref_cnt = stats(ref, "2001-2010 avg")
tar_val, tar_cnt = stats(tar, "2016")
if ref_cnt == 0 or tar_cnt == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()
if ref_val is None or tar_val is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()
print("<answer>A</answer>" if tar_val > ref_val else "<answer>B</answer>")
